items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I had Dizzy Gillespie, and that’s where he played, bebop. “Hot Mallets” did you ever hear that record?

ctx.x: The first time, you know I had a contract with RCA Victor to make all sorts of jazz records. And you speak about the different characters. And you know the first time the beboppers ever played, I had Dizzy Gillespie, and that’s where he played, bebop. “Hot Mallets” did you ever hear that record?
